notes: ACCESS: Chrome connector only (Claude-in-Chrome MCP), in my own tab. The site sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge; the interstitial never completed because the MCP tab was background-throttled (document.visibilityState was 'hidden', so requestAnimationFrame never fired). Patching visibility and rAF in the page context let the challenge finish, and the cf_clearance cookie then covered every later request. All later reads were same-origin fetch() of the server-rendered category HTML from that tab; no curl, requests, proxy or WebFetch was used. ROBOTS: ClaudeBot, Claude-User and Claude-SearchBot are named in robots.txt and given Allow: /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt and /llm/* with no full-site Disallow - explicit permission, not a block. TREE: union of (a) the homepage mega-menu (535 category links across 14 departments), (b) each department and section page's own browse-nav sub-category strip (.js-category-nav) and (c) the category sitemap (sitemap_category-1.xml, 1849 category URLs). The sitemap is dominated by colour/material/size/price re-cuts, so the mega-menu plus browse-nav union was used as the taxonomy and the sitemap was used only to confirm nothing structural was missing. The browse nav added real nodes the mega-menu omits: Outdoor Coffee & Side Tables, Outdoor Benches, Hammocks, the entire Outdoor Chairs/Tables/Sofas third level, Kids Bedroom Storage's five children, End of Bed and Study Desks. QTY: every number is the page's own rendered header 'N Results', and the h1 was checked to match the node asked for. That check mattered - two plausible slugs I tried (Laundry-Cupboards-C1955230 and Kitchen-and-Laundry-Cabinets-C1955232) did not 404: they served a '$2 Shipping' listing of 41757 and the homepage respectively, confirming bad slugs serve plausible wrong pages on this platform. The header was corroborated against an independent tile enumeration (unique a.productbox data-sku) on five single-page categories: Adirondack Chairs 5/5, Desk Hutches 2/2, Kids Wardrobes 8/8, Room Dividers 44/44, Bar Tables 26/26 - exact, no padding and no colourway inflation. Page size is 48. DEPTH: below the leaves listed here the browse nav offers only facet re-cuts - Sofas into Leather/Fabric/2 Seater/3 Seater, Beds into Single/Double/Queen/King, Bathroom Vanities into Wall Hung/Freestanding/450mm/600mm, Coffee Tables into Glass Coffee Tables, Ottomans into Storage Ottomans, Kids Beds into Kids Single/Toddler/Novelty. Those are excluded as price/colour/material/size filter pages. Outdoor is the one branch with a genuine third level (Outdoor Chairs 388 vs children 182+56+88+5+59=390; Outdoor Tables 349 vs 141+33+136+25=335; Outdoor Sofas & Lounge Sets 201 vs 73+36+54+14+29=206), so those three parents are grouping rows and their children are the leaves. DUPLICATES FOUND AND RESOLVED: 'Laundry Cupboards' (Laundry-Cupboards-C1961627, 67) serves the identical product list to 'Cupboards' (Cupboards-C1955234, 67), so only Cupboards is emitted. 'End of Bed' (End-of-Bed-C1955880, 134) serves the identical list to 'Entryway Benches' (Entryway-Benches-C1955883, 134, 48 of 48 SKUs matching on page 1), so only Entryway Benches is emitted. 'Outdoor Bar Furniture' (97) is a roll-up of Outdoor Bar Stools (59) and Outdoor Bar Tables (33), both emitted under Outdoor Chairs and Outdoor Tables, so the roll-up is not emitted. Nodes that repeat across sections (Console Tables, Buffets & Sideboards, Cupboards, Display Cabinets, Shoe Racks, Bookcases & Shelves, Storage Cabinets, Filing Cabinets) are emitted once. EXCLUDED: Mattresses, Cot Mattresses, Air Mattresses and all bedding (the Bed & Bath department was walked and contains no furniture); Furniture Covers and Product Care & Accessories; Boxes & Baskets, Laundry Baskets, Toy Boxes & Storage, Kids Toy Boxes & Storage, Food Containers, Magazine Racks, Rubbish Bins and Wall Hooks & Racks as standalone storage/organisers; Floating Shelves & Wall Shelving as wall shelving; Sheds & Outdoor Storage, Mailboxes, Umbrellas & Gazebos, BBQs, Fire Pits, Outdoor Bean Bags and Outdoor Play; all Lighting, Mirrors (including Bathroom Mirrors and Kids Mirrors), Clocks, Wall Art, Rugs, Cushions, Plant Pots & Stands and Doormats; all bathroom fixtures (basins, taps, showers, bathtubs, toilets, towel rails, Bathroom Packages); Kitchen & Laundry Cabinets (30 - titles inspected: fitted laundry cabinets with sinks, wall cabinets, end panels and fillers, i.e. joinery rather than freestanding furniture); High Chairs & Seats (filed by the site under Feeding/baby gear); and all Sale, Clearance, New Arrivals, Free Shipping, View all and price-band nodes plus the department-level Chairs/Tables/Benches cross-cut roll-ups. The Decor department was also walked and contains no furniture. SANITY: the Furniture department header reads 8906 and section headers differ per node (Bedroom 2147, Living Room 3351, Kitchen & Dining 2077, Outdoor Furniture 1634, Home Office 775, Commercial Office 355, Kids Furniture 510, Nursery 73), so the number is not a constant site-wide total. Hallway Furniture reads 5431, far above the sum of its own children, so it was left as a grouping row with qty null rather than trusted. No 403, CAPTCHA or rate limit occurred after the initial challenge cleared.
